name: customization_state
description: Read Rose's customization controls: the theme (oxblood, glacier or winds), the Home column count (0 means automatic), the Oxblood wallpaper variant, the font, and the glasses-on hook. Also reports whether Home has drawn the latest change (home.applied) and the column count Home actually draws (home.effectiveColumns, null until drawn), and whether this phone has a real glasses-worn signal, which theme the system surfaces confirmed drawing (system.shown, system.applied), and whether the Rose screen has drawn it (conversation.shown, conversation.applied, conversation.state). Read this before relative changes and to verify a change.

name: customization_home_columns
description: Set how many columns Rose Home uses, live, with no OS rebuild. 0 restores the automatic count (four on a phone). Apps keep their order and reflow intact; none are added or removed. Home uses fewer columns if that many cells cannot fit the screen: a phone fits three to five. verified means the preference is saved, not that Home shows it: report home.effectiveColumns as the count Home draws, and when home.applied is false say Home has not shown the change yet.

name: customization_wallpaper
description: Choose one of Rose's curated Oxblood wallpaper variations for Home, live. classic is the shipped Oxblood field; garnet is a brighter red, ember a warmer orange-red, velvet much deeper and dusk a cooler wine. All are Oxblood and apply only while the theme is Oxblood: in another theme the phone refuses the change, because that theme draws its own wallpaper. Arbitrary images are not supported.

name: customization_font
description: Choose Rose's font from the fonts bundled on the phone, live. default restores Rose's shipped type: Nunito for conversation text and the system sans-serif for Home labels. nunito, sans, serif, condensed and mono apply one family to the Home date, Home and folder labels, and Rose's conversation text and cards drawn after the change; some built-in controls and widgets keep their own faces, and other apps are not affected.

name: customization_glasses_hook
description: Turn the glasses-on hook on or off, or change what it does: action tray brings Rose Home and its tray forward, and action app opens packageName. The hook runs once each time the glasses go on. Glasses on means any Bluetooth audio device connecting, and removal means the last one disconnecting; this is the owner's chosen signal, not a worn sensor, so other Bluetooth headphones count too. The returned state names the signal. Supply at least one of enabled, action or packageName.

name: customization_theme
description: Switch Rose's theme, live: oxblood is the shipped deep red; glacier is cool mineral blue with its own wallpaper; winds is light: airy mint folds and pale folded glass with dark teal text and pale yellow actions, with its own wallpaper. The theme recolours Rose Home, the Rose screen, the tray and chin, notifications and the keyboard; Home columns, the font, app icons and the glasses-on hook are kept, and Oxblood's chosen wallpaper variant comes back when Oxblood does. The choice survives a restart. verified means saved: report it as done only when home.applied, conversation.applied and system.applied confirm this exact theme. The Rose screen can defer until Return, Stop or Background Work closes; until then say what has not shown it yet. Missing acknowledgment is not success.
